a: Avoid SELECT * in production; select needed columns.
OR in joins can prevent index use; rewrite carefully.
WHERE YEAR(col)=2024 often kills index use; rewrite ranges.
Type mismatches can force scans and wrong comparisons.
Lazy loading loops cause N+1 queries.
Unbounded queries can return huge results.
Too many indexes slow writes; index for real queries.
Deep OFFSET pagination gets slower as pages increase.
Nullable columns invite null bugs; constrain when possible.
Extremely complex SQL can be hard to test; balance layers.
